answer.justification: The lesser sac (omental bursa) lies posterior to the stomach and anterior to the pancreas. Laparoscopic access to the pancreatic body/tail is gained by opening the lesser omentum, specifically the gastrohepatic ligament connecting the stomach to the liver. The other ligaments do not provide this route.
